title: Welcome
body:
⚽ **WELCOME TO ANTRIM NEWTOWNABBEY DISABILITY FC!**

Welcome to the official website of Antrim Newtownabbey Disability FC!

Founded in August 2020, our club is dedicated to providing inclusive football opportunities for children, young people and adults of all abilities.

Our motto is **Ability Not Disability**, and we believe everyone deserves the opportunity to enjoy football, make friends and build confidence.

**Our weekly training sessions**

📍 V36 Synthetic Pitch, Newtownabbey

📅 Every Wednesday

⚽ Ages 7–16: 7pm–8pm

⚽ Ages 16+: 8pm–9pm

Alongside football, we are proud to support community inclusion, volunteering and mental health awareness through programmes such as Kicking Off Conversations.

We welcome enquiries from new players, parents, volunteers and potential sponsors.

📧 antrimnewtownabbeydisabilityfc@gmail.com

**One Club. One Team. One Standard.**

**Ability Not Disability.**
